description.en: Devices as E2B sandboxes (E2B cloud or self-hosted): files kept by pausing the sandbox, templates built from the published image, an allowlist or the open internet with local ranges denied (E2B's metadata service stays reachable)
description.zh: 以 E2B 沙箱承载设备（E2B 云或自托管）：暂停沙箱保留文件，从已发布镜像构建模板，网络为出站白名单或开放公网（拒绝私有、回环与链路本地地址；E2B 元数据端点仍可达，见 README）
